headline: Keep lane ownership in step with the work

V26-3591.title: Make region spans follow the work: release on landing, carve in one step, and let a lane check its own claims

criteria.text: c1: When a story lands, its spans are released, and its lane's other spans are re-based to the new base or named as needing a regrant. No claim is left that blocks a later grant on its file.
c2: A carve either takes effect whole or changes nothing, including under a concurrent record write.
c3: Granting a span that touches one of the same lane's spans on the same file leaves one span.
c4: A lane can list, in one command, every line its diff changes outside its claims.
c5: The lead can see whether the queue would refuse a candidate's ownership, and which claimed lines each lane's diff touches.

V26-3570.title: Make region grants show and resolve their lines, so a wrong span can't pass unnoticed

criteria.text: c1: Every region grant prints the granted span's first and last lines at the base.
c2: An anchor resolves to its enclosing block at the base, and an ambiguous or missing anchor is refused, naming the candidates.
c3: A span that would cut a statement in two is refused, naming it.
c4: An insertion at a span's edge is made legal by widening, and the widening is printed.
c5: The lane brief asks lanes for anchors or quoted lines.

V26-3476.title: Prove ownership transfers wait for lead acceptance with a deterministic race fixture

criteria.text: c1: The test exercises the normal lead acceptance and ownership commands with explicit process signals.
c2: The production implementation passes.
c3: Removing the ownership lock makes the fixture fail.

V26-3564.title: Say when a lane changes a file it doesn't hold, and show shared files when lanes split them

criteria.text: c1: A pushed change to a file its lane doesn't hold appears in "Needs you" naming the lane and file, and clears when the change is gone or the file is granted.
c2: A change to a regenerable shared file raises nothing.
c3: With region claims in the record, the live page offers the files view, and its shelf, solid and hollow spines, shared splits and file reading match the record and the lanes' branches.
c4: With no region claims, the page shows no files view.
c5: A lane branch that can't be read leaves the view and the item saying so, rather than showing stale changes as current.

V26-3589.title: Show a delivery's integration step on the live view
V26-3589.why: The operator added it on 2026-11-18 as a third lane; its plan is already reviewed, and this delivery is itself an integration delivery that needs the view.

criteria.text: c1: The record carries the delivery's integration base and target, and the view's payload passes them through; a delivery without one carries neither.

c2: The lead's integration facts are journalled: each merge of the target into the integration candidate with its conflicted paths, each `lead-suite` run with its head and result, each integration review round with its head, and the change request into the target and its merge.
c3: Once every piece has landed on the integration base and before the change request merges, the headline reads in two beats and names the target, with the target's drift and the catch-up count.
c4: The line map draws the integration line's four stops past the integration base and the target below it, each stop's state read from the journal.
c5: The "Before it rejoins" ledger shows each proof with the head it was taken at, struck through when a later integration fact names a newer head.
c6: A delivery with no integration target renders byte for byte as before (the existing goldens are unchanged).
